verdict.rationale: Convex has no built-in natural-language interface of its own. It does ship a first-party MCP server whose tools let AI agents interact with a deployment, plus agent setup prompts, so users can drive Convex in natural language through an external agent. That is the product's own documented enablement, but the natural-language layer itself comes from the user's chosen agent. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface in the product, documentation of which operations the MCP tools cover, and independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation working in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The Convex Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides several tools that allow AI agents to interact with your Convex deployment.
Starting a new project is as easy as asking your agent to create a new app with Convex.
Copy the setup prompt for your agent. Works great with any model, any agent, any editor
